source_unit.accepted_sibling_comparisons: Both exact at original VMAs in each candidate source-unit link; 44/44 and 128/128 bytes.
source_unit.composition_method: Compare the two candidate-unit C siblings, unchanged 192 ROM bytes for intervening ASM, and the isolated candidate linked at the target VMA against ROM [0x36EDC,0x370FC). The candidate target is short, so this is a failing composition, not a UNIT_EXACT claim.

behavior.role: increment object acquisition counters, select an optional side-effect helper or capacity gate, then return a size-2 pool allocation

arguments.a0: homed to 0x18(sp), not dereferenced by the target; null and non-null owner values have no target-side effect

behavior.counter_updates: lhu D_8016DAB0; increment with 16-bit wrap; store with sh before all gate/allocator paths. Compare incremented value with lhu D_8016DAB2 and update high-water with sh only when the new value is greater. Do not roll the increment back on failure.
behavior.helper_path: If lw D_8006D320 is nonzero, call func_80036058_36C58(pointer,1). The helper zero/nonzero result branches both reconverge at allocation; helper result does not gate allocation.
behavior.capacity_path: If D_8006D320 is zero, compute unsigned lhu D_8006D354 minus signed lh D_8016DADC and allocate only when the 32-bit signed difference is positive; otherwise return null.
behavior.allocator: Call func_80035D8C_3698C(2), return its result including null.
behavior.caller_effect: Callers initialize the returned object and link it into owner +0x78; callers do not establish null safety before using returned objects.
behavior.callbacks: One optional call to func_80036058_36C58(pointer,1); allocator call follows if capacity/helper path permits.
behavior.list_mutation: None: target does not free, clear, mark, initialize or link list nodes.

host_model.negative_control: An intentionally incorrect host model that returned null when the helper returned zero was rejected by the expected allocation-result assertion.
host_model.limitations: The host test is a ROM-derived reference model, not production C for 80036448; helper internals and live game state are not modeled.

candidate_trials.hypothesis: Materialize counter and high-water addresses through explicit local pointers and keep the helper/allocator sequence direct.
candidate_trials.mismatch: Original begins addiu $sp,$sp,-0x18 (0x27BDFFE8); candidate begins lui $a2,0x8017 (0x3C068017).

candidate_trials.variant: v2 volatile globals and direct counter values
candidate_trials.hypothesis: Use volatile global reads and reordered locals to keep the stack prologue first while varying counter/high-water lifetime.
candidate_trials.mismatch: Original +0x04 is lui $v0,0x8017; candidate +0x04 stores $a0 at 0x18($sp).

candidate_trials.variant: v3 pointer aliases plus cached helper owner
candidate_trials.hypothesis: Test whether aliasing counter addresses and caching the optional helper owner changes global-load and stack-home ordering.
candidate_trials.mismatch: Same first mismatch and exact linked bytes as v1; original starts with stack adjustment while candidate starts with counter-address lui.

candidate_trials.variant: v4 volatile globals and explicit count snapshots
candidate_trials.hypothesis: Combine volatile globals with explicit current/high-water snapshots to influence saved-register lifetime and update ordering.
candidate_trials.mismatch: Original begins with stack adjustment; candidate begins with counter-address lui before its frame adjustment.

decision.reason: No IDO candidate matched the 180-byte original. v2 moved the first mismatch only to +0x04; v3 reproduced v1’s linked bytes; v4 regressed. Accepted C siblings remained exact, but the candidate unit composition was short and nonexact. Keep GLOBAL_ASM; do not run a full-ROM build or inventory without a unit-exact candidate.
